identity.name: GlassWorm macOS Wave — Poisoned VS Code Extension → Keychain, LaunchAgent, Credential Staging and Archive Send
identity.summary: Fourth GlassWorm wave, retargeted at macOS developers: a trojanized Open VSX extension runs in the VS Code extension host, spawns a scripting host, reaches for Keychain material, installs a LaunchAgent, stages credential files and archives them to a hard-coded server.
identity.description: Built from the Palo Alto Networks Security Operations write-up of the macOS wave of GlassWorm (https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/security-operations/glassworm-goes-mac-fresh-infrastructure-new-tricks/). The public report describes an encrypted loader whose key is held in the extension, a timer-delayed second stage, C2 discovery through a blockchain transaction memo, a macOS-specific payload that targets Keychain and developer credential stores, LaunchAgent persistence, local staging and an HTTP POST of the collected archive to a remote endpoint. CortexSim does not reproduce the loader or the blockchain lookup. It runs a benign canary extension that produces the same endpoint observables, all as children of the VS Code extension host: an install into the user's extensions directory, a scripting-host child at activation, a security-utility call against a decoy keychain file, a no-op LaunchAgent written and loaded with launchctl, a read of several decoy credential-named files copied to a staging directory, and a tar of that directory that is sent only when an authorised sink is configured. Every detection keys on the causality chain (causality_id and the VS Code image-name set), never on a username, because the Causality Group Owner is the IDE itself. The Cortex Agentic Endpoint Security view of the same install (inventory, publisher, permissions, risk score, guardrail verdict) is a product observation the DC records, not a scored detection. The encrypted-loader and timer-delay code-scan detection is described in the card, not exercised. Precondition: the archive-send XQL `KOI-009 Archive Sent From IDE Lineage To Non Marketplace Host` is only exercised when the operator has configured an authorised sink via CORTEXSIM_C2_URL, and the NGFW XQL `KOI-009 NGFW Session From IDE Host To Non Marketplace Destination` additionally needs an NGFW in path; both require at least one row. With no sink the step resolves not_reached, never a pass and never a fail. Sink binding: the archive-send and NGFW queries match the canary sink host cortexsim-canary.invalid, which the component logs as its intended destination and which matches nothing by default; when the DC configures an authorised sink via CORTEXSIM_C2_URL they substitute that sink host in the destination predicate of both queries. The NGFW query carries no source predicate because the lab endpoint's address is unknown at authoring time, so the DC scopes the source to the lab endpoint. The field names in the NGFW dataset (panw_ngfw_traffic_raw) still need live-tenant confirmation, as for any raw-source card.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Launch Agent

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-KOI-009 — GlassWorm macOS wave SAFE-MODE emulation via the prettier-pro-canary VS Code extension (decoy-only, URI-triggered).

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR / XSIAM agent installed on the macOS lab endpoint so per-process causality telemetry reaches xdr_data.
VS Code with its `code` CLI on PATH, so the canary .vsix installs through the IDE's own main-process image.

payload.code:
# SAFE-MODE — SIM-KOI-009 GlassWorm macOS emulation (NON-DESTRUCTIVE, decoy-only).
# Installs the in-tree canary extension, then drives each step through the
# extension's vscode:// URI handler so the actions run as children of the
# extension host. Nothing leaves the host unless CORTEXSIM_C2_URL is set.
set -euo pipefail
export CORTEXSIM_KOI009_DECOY_ROOT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/koi009.XXXXXX)"
code --install-extension "${VSIX_PATH}" --force
open -a "Visual Studio Code"
for s in step-03 step-04 step-05 step-06; do
  open "vscode://cortexsim-canary.prettier-pro-canary/${s}"
  sleep 5
done
echo "[CortexSim][SAFE-MODE] SIM-KOI-009 decoy root: ${CORTEXSIM_KOI009_DECOY_ROOT}"

input_variables.name: VSIX_PATH
input_variables.description: Canary extension package installed through the IDE CLI.

expected_artifacts.description: New directory for the canary extension under the user's VS Code extensions path, created by the IDE main-process image running the code CLI.
One osascript child of the extension host at activation, which exits at once.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: action_process_image_name = "osascript" and causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")

expected_artifacts.description: security find-generic-password against a decoy *.keychain-db file, as an extension-host child.
LaunchAgent plist com.cortexsim.CORTEXSIM-CANARY.koi009.plist written under ~/Library/LaunchAgents and loaded with launchctl bootstrap (program /usr/bin/true).
Decoy credential-named files read, then copied into a staging directory in the decoy tree.
tar over the staging directory; sent to CORTEXSIM_C2_URL only when that sink is set.

cleanup.code:
launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/com.cortexsim.CORTEXSIM-CANARY.koi009" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.cortexsim.CORTEXSIM-CANARY.koi009.plist"
code --uninstall-extension cortexsim-canary.prettier-pro-canary 2>/dev/null || true
find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'koi009.*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-KOI-009 cleanup complete.'

biocs.name: KOI-009 Keychain Access By IDE Descendant
biocs.description: A child of the VS Code extension host runs the security utility against a keychain database file. Legitimate extensions do not read Keychain material; the report's macOS payload targets it directly. CortexSim points the call at a decoy *.keychain-db only.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter action_process_image_name = "security"
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains_any ("find-generic-password", "find-internet-password", "dump-keychain") and action_process_image_command_line contains ".keychain-db"
| comp count() as keychain_calls by agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, action_process_image_command_line
| filter keychain_calls >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, action_process_image_command_line, keychain_calls

biocs.name: KOI-009 LaunchAgent Written And Loaded From IDE Lineage
biocs.description: A descendant of the IDE bootstraps a user LaunchAgent with launchctl, the persistence step in the macOS wave. The plist is written by the same lineage immediately before; the load command is the single-event anchor that carries the plist path.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter action_process_image_name = "launchctl"
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "bootstrap" and action_process_image_command_line contains "/Library/LaunchAgents/"
| comp count() as agent_loads by agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, action_process_image_command_line
| filter agent_loads >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, action_process_image_command_line, agent_loads

biocs.name: KOI-009 Multi Credential File Read Under IDE CGO
biocs.description: Three or more distinct credential-named files (npm token file, git credentials, SSH key, editor storage, keychain copy) are read in one window by a process in the IDE's causality chain. An extension that reads this set is stealing, not formatting.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE
| filter event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_OPEN, ENUM.FILE_READ)
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter action_file_path contains_any (".npmrc", ".git-credentials", "id_rsa", "id_ed25519", "storage.json", "state.vscdb", ".keychain-db", "credentials.json")
| comp count_distinct(action_file_path) as secret_files_read by agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, actor_process_image_name
| filter secret_files_read >= 3
| fields agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, actor_process_image_name, secret_files_read

xql_queries.name: KOI-009 VS Code Extension Install Creates Unknown Publisher Extension Directory
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW
| filter action_file_path contains "/.vscode/extensions/"
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code") or actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter action_file_path !~= "/\.vscode/extensions/(ms-|github\.|redhat\.|vscode\.)"
| fields _time, agent_hostname, causality_id, actor_process_image_name, action_file_path

xql_queries.name: KOI-009 Staging Directory Created Under IDE Lineage
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE)
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter action_file_path contains_any ("/staging/", "/ijewf/")
| fields _time, agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, action_file_path

xql_queries.name: KOI-009 Archive Sent From IDE Lineage To Non Marketplace Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter dst_action_external_hostname = "cortexsim-canary.invalid" or action_external_hostname = "cortexsim-canary.invalid"
| filter action_total_upload > 0
| fields _time, agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_instance_id, dst_action_external_hostname, action_remote_ip, action_external_port, action_total_upload

xql_queries.name: KOI-009 NGFW Session From IDE Host To Non Marketplace Destination
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter action = "allow"
| filter dst_host = "cortexsim-canary.invalid"
| filter action_total_upload > 0
| comp sum(action_total_upload) as bytes_out, count() as sessions by src_ip, dst_ip, dst_host
| fields src_ip, dst_ip, dst_host, sessions, bytes_out

abiocs.name: KOI-009 IDE Extension Host Spawns Scripting Host For First Seen Publisher
abiocs.description: Behavioral-ML deviation: the VS Code extension host, from an extension whose publisher has no prior install on this endpoint, spawns a macOS scripting-interpreter child at activation. Extension hosts rarely spawn osascript; a first-seen publisher doing it in the first minute is the loader's activation shape.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("Electron", "Code Helper (Plugin)", "Code Helper", "code")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("osascript", "sh", "bash", "zsh")
| filter action_process_signature_status != ENUM.SIGNED or action_process_image_name = "osascript"
| comp count() as script_spawns, values(action_process_image_command_line) as child_cmdlines by agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter script_spawns >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_id, causality_actor_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_instance_id, child_cmdlines, script_spawns
abiocs.causality_anchor: The VS Code main/extension-host process (Causality Group Owner) and its causality_actor_process_instance_id; the deviation is a scripting-host child from a publisher first seen on this endpoint, against the baseline of extension hosts that spawn no interpreters.

correlation_rules.name: GlassWorm macOS Wave — Extension Host Scripting, Keychain, LaunchAgent, Credential Read and Archive Send
correlation_rules.logic: ABIOC(KOI-009 IDE Extension Host Spawns Scripting Host For First Seen Publisher) FOLLOWED_BY BIOC(KOI-009 Keychain Access By IDE Descendant) FOLLOWED_BY BIOC(KOI-009 LaunchAgent Written And Loaded From IDE Lineage) FOLLOWED_BY BIOC(KOI-009 Multi Credential File Read Under IDE CGO) FOLLOWED_BY XQL(KOI-009 Archive Sent From IDE Lineage To Non Marketplace Host) — all stitched by shared agent_hostname and causality_id (CGO = the VS Code IDE) so the activation-time scripting host, Keychain access, LaunchAgent persistence, credential read and archive send collapse into ONE GlassWorm incident.

threat_scenarios.name: GlassWorm macOS Wave — Poisoned IDE Extension to Credential Theft
threat_scenarios.description: Detect a trojanized IDE extension end to end on a macOS developer endpoint: install, activation-time scripting host, Keychain access, LaunchAgent persistence, credential staging and archive send, stitched into one causality-aware incident, with the Agentic Endpoint Security inventory view recorded alongside.

threat_steps.objective: The install and activation-time behaviour fire under the IDE causality chain, and the AES inventory shows the extension.
preconditions: macOS endpoint with the Cortex agent and VS Code installed.
steps: Install the canary .vsix through the code CLI and launch the IDE.
Observe the extension-directory XQL and the scripting-host ABIOC.
Record the extension's AES inventory entry and risk score.
success_criteria: XQL `KOI-009 VS Code Extension Install Creates Unknown Publisher Extension Directory` returns the canary directory.
ABIOC `KOI-009 IDE Extension Host Spawns Scripting Host For First Seen Publisher` fires.

threat_steps.objective: Keychain, persistence, credential read and archive-send fire and correlate into one incident.
preconditions: TS-KOI-009A executed within the correlation window.
CORTEXSIM_C2_URL names an authorised sink for the archive-send and NGFW queries; without it step 06 resolves not_reached (never a pass, never a fail).
steps: Trigger steps 03 to 06 through the extension's URI handler.
Observe the Keychain, LaunchAgent and credential-read BIOCs and the archive-send XQL.
Confirm correlation CR-KOI-0009 stitches every stage into one incident.
success_criteria: BIOC `KOI-009 Keychain Access By IDE Descendant` fires.
BIOC `KOI-009 LaunchAgent Written And Loaded From IDE Lineage` fires.
BIOC `KOI-009 Multi Credential File Read Under IDE CGO` fires.

When a sink is configured via CORTEXSIM_C2_URL, correlation `CR-KOI-0009` raises exactly one GlassWorm incident; with no sink the chain cannot complete and step 06 resolves not_reached, never a pass and never a fail.
XQL `KOI-009 Archive Sent From IDE Lineage To Non Marketplace Host` returns at least one row when a sink is configured; with no sink the step is not_reached.
XQL `KOI-009 NGFW Session From IDE Host To Non Marketplace Destination` returns at least one row when a sink is configured and an NGFW is in path; otherwise not_reached.

preventive_controls: Allow only approved IDE extensions: restrict installs to a vetted publisher list or an internal registry gateway, and turn on delayed-access or version-update cooldown guardrails so a freshly published update is not installed the day it ships.
Remove Open VSX and Marketplace access for developer endpoints that do not need it, and alert on any install from a publisher not previously seen in the fleet.
Keep long-lived credentials out of developer home directories: use short-lived tokens, a credential helper and hardware-backed SSH keys so a file read yields nothing reusable.
Alert on user LaunchAgent creation by any process descended from an IDE; developer tooling has no reason to install login persistence.
detection_engineering: Anchor on causality_id and the VS Code image-name set (Electron, Code Helper (Plugin), Code Helper, code), never on a username: the IDE is the Causality Group Owner and every later stage is its descendant.
Treat an extension host that spawns osascript, security, launchctl or tar as the signal; none of these is part of normal extension behaviour.
Require three or more distinct credential-named files read in one window by the IDE chain before alerting on credential theft, to keep a single settings read quiet.
Pair the endpoint chain with NGFW egress to a non-marketplace destination when a firewall is in path, and with the Agentic Endpoint Security inventory view for the install itself.
